name: Gisa's griffin creature
description: A fabled race of semi-intelligent beasts resembling a cross between a bird of prey and a large cat.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of the time stream, taking most of Dominaria's griffins with it.
timeline.quote: When Zhalfir was phased out of the time stream by the Planeswalker Teferi

citation.text: "Griffin", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravnican griffins adapt to hunting in the streets after the oceans dry up.

citation.text: "Griffin", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises a griffin-manticore from the ground and Geralf borrows a jackalope, and the siblings ride for Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: the two of them were off, riding across the wide-open plains of Thunder Junction toward their distant, unpleasant destination.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf uses the angel's blood to stitch a construct from Gisa's griffin to fight the corpsipede.
timeline.quote: Wild laughter rose in the distance, followed by Geralf walking back into view, leading a horrifying construct behind him.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

relations.note: Gisa calls the griffin creature out of the ground.
relations.quote: the creature she'd been calling ripped itself out of the earth.
